crie um aplicativo web para transcrever qualquer arquivo em texto, sendo audio, video etc.
com opção para fazer upload do arquivo ou colar o link e historico de transcrições

**Envisioning the Web App**

I'm starting to visualize this transcription web app. I'm focusing on user experience, especially how to make the upload/link process seamless. I need to make sure the transcription history is accessible and intuitive, and I'm already thinking about a sleek, modern aesthetic that meets world-class senior frontend engineer standards. I'm prioritizing performance and responsiveness, too.


**Defining the Tech Stack**

I've solidified the tech stack: React 18+, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS will be the frontend foundation. For transcription, I'll leverage the Gemini API (`@google/genai`) using `gemini-3-flash-preview` for speed and accuracy. Lucide React will provide the icons. Local storage will handle history. I'm focusing on a responsive design. I'm also planning the upload/link process using `<input type="file">` and base64. For links, I'm leaning toward using Gemini with `inlineData` due to multimodal capabilities.


**Refining the File Handling**

I'm now zeroing in on file transcription. Large video files could hit base64 limits, so I'll add a warning or a file size limit. History will definitely go into `localStorage`. I'm structuring the project with specific files in mind: metadata, index, app, components, services, and types.
